dict.string: PlowR uses your location to show where you are on the route map, estimate arrival times for your clients, and show your local weather.
During a route, PlowR uses your location in the background to notice when you leave a stop, so it can prompt you to notify the next client.

PlowR uses your camera to capture before and after photos of service stops, and to scan business cards when adding new clients.
PlowR saves a job photo to your photo library when you choose Save Image.
PlowR adds your scheduled visits to Calendar so they appear alongside your other appointments.
